item.title: Legacy and Expertise in Precision Milling Machinery
item.description:
Legacy and Expertise in Precision Milling Machinery
#

Chung Sing Machinery Co., Ltd, based in Taichung, Taiwan, has been a leading force in the design and manufacturing of boring and milling machines since its establishment in 1988. Operating under the brand name “FORTWORTH,” the company brings over three decades of experience to the development, engineering, and production of high-quality milling machinery.

Horizontal Boring & Milling Machines: Engineered for Performance
#

Chung Sing Machinery offers a comprehensive range of horizontal boring and milling machines, each crafted from premium cast iron to guarantee exceptional stability and longevity. These machines are engineered to meet the demanding requirements of modern manufacturing, providing reliable solutions for precision machining tasks.

item.title: Precision Boring and Milling Solutions for Modern Manufacturing
item.description:
Precision Boring and Milling Solutions for Modern Manufacturing
#

Established in 1988, Fortworth (Chung Sing Machinery) has dedicated decades to the development and manufacturing of high-precision boring and milling machines in Taiwan. Our machines are engineered with meticulous craftsmanship, ensuring maximum accuracy, stability, and processing efficiency for a wide range of industrial applications.
